description: Comptage routier is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville d'Agen. Road counting points are sensors that collect traffic data by measuring the number of vehicles, their speed, and their category (light or heavy) on specific road segments. Coverage: Ville d'Agen. The portal shows the English title as "Road counting" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville d'Agen. Its keywords include trafic-routier, comptage-routier, comptage. The listing shows 2024-08-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
